reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a Forsage “3 get 3” strategy that claims users can earn thousands of BUSD daily and $69,300 quickly through repeated matrix steps and partner slot activation. It directs viewers to install Trust Wallet and deposit $85, claiming the investment will be returned instantly when three partners activate slots, while also stating that income is not guaranteed.

citations.quote: ~ Join FORSAGE Now! $Earn$ Non-Stop Crypto by Network Marketing ~
when you register on vsage with 85 dollars b usd you open both programs simultaneously
in both these programs vsage x3 and vs X4, there are 12 slots. Each subsequent slot you purchase is 2 times the value of the previous one, and it generates twice the income as well.
Your 3 partners will activate 3 slots on X three and X four, and your $85 investment will be funded back instantly and automatically to your trust wallet.
Your three partners will continue to follow you through the matrix until you have reached slot 12 on X three and X four

opening.argument: The presentation expressly qualifies its earnings discussion rather than guaranteeing a result: it says the program is “not a get-rich-quick scheme,” that “Income is not guaranteed,” and that earning thousands requires effort. That is a material risk warning, not a promise that every viewer will profit. It also describes the program as decentralized and says members control their own wallet keys, giving viewers information about how responsibility and risk are allocated. A careful viewer is therefore told both the potential upside and the uncertainty before deciding whether to participate.

citations.quote: it is important to realize for signs is not a get-rich-quick scheme. Income is not guaranteed, and if you want to earn thousands of dollars in BUSD, you need to put in the effort.
forage never take or store members cryptocurrency in any centralized location. So it's completely secure.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening emphasizes promotional earnings and the $85 contribution, but it omits the explicit qualification that income is not guaranteed and that effort is required. “Earn $69,300” is promotional language, yet the spoken disclaimer prevents that slogan from being read as a universal promise. The material also presents the contribution and wallet process openly rather than concealing it.

citations.quote: Income is not guaranteed
you need to put in the effort
install the trust wallet app on your phone and deposit 85 dollars in BUSD

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The disclaimer does not neutralize the central solicitation. The same presentation tells viewers they can earn thousands daily, claims an unlimited income potential, instructs them to deposit $85, and links repayment to three partners. Saying income is not guaranteed is compatible with recruiting people into a structure whose advertised returns depend on recruiting others; it does not establish that the opportunity is legitimate or that the stated repayment will occur.

citations.quote: earn thousands of dollars in BUSD daily pay directly and instantly
Your 3 partners will activate 3 slots on X three and X four, and your $85 investment will be funded back instantly and automatically to your trust wallet.
the income potential is unlimited

opening.argument: The content can reasonably be understood as an operational explanation of how the platform's programs are organized. It explicitly asks how the “3K3 strategy” works, then explains the X3 and X4 programs, slot progression, partner placement, and activation sequence. The sampled presentation likewise contains a slide titled “HOW DOES THE 3 GET 3 STRATEGY ON FORSAGE WORK,” which is consistent with a tutorial or demonstration of a system. Explaining a process, including its claimed economics, does not by itself prove that the presenter is certifying the outcome.

citations.quote: how does the 3K3 strategy on Versaages work in the Versaages X3 program
Each subsequent slot you purchase is 2 times the value of the previous one, and it generates twice the income as well.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats every explanation of the mechanism as a solicitation, but the supplied material also plainly teaches the sequence: it describes simultaneous program enrollment, slot levels, partner activation, and repeated steps. A tutorial can contain a call to action without losing its explanatory character. The presenter identifies the process and its conditions rather than hiding how participation is supposed to work.

citations.quote: On the 3 get 3 strategy, we activate the first 3 slots on X3 and X4.
Your three partners will continue to follow you through the matrix until you have reached slot 12 on X three and X four

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The explanation is not neutral instruction. It repeatedly presents the system as a way to earn, shows the $85 return, and ends by directing viewers to install a wallet, deposit funds, and contact the person who shared the video. Describing the mechanism in detail makes the recruitment pitch more actionable; it does not convert the pitch into education or prove the claims being demonstrated.

citations.quote: install the trust wallet app on your phone and deposit 85 dollars in BUSD and then contact the person who shared with you this video.

opening.argument: At most, the material presents a paid referral-style promotion for access to a cryptocurrency program. It identifies a stated $85 entry amount and explains that the participant uses a personal wallet, but it does not ask viewers to surrender private keys, send credentials, or place funds with the presenter. The spoken account says members control their own wallet keys, and the material describes payments as going directly to members. Those features leave open an ordinary promotional interpretation rather than establishing custody, theft, or a deceptive payment outcome.

citations.quote: forage never take or store members cryptocurrency in any centralized location.
stored in their personal Beusd wallets which they control the private keys
when you register on vsage with 85 dollars b usd you open both programs simultaneously

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening calls the structure a scam mechanism, but the evidence does not show the presenter requesting private keys or taking custody of viewers' cryptocurrency. It describes a transparent entry price, wallet-based participation, and a stated direct-payment arrangement. A referral promotion with a disclosed cost and disclosed steps should not be treated as fraudulent merely because it offers commissions or requires effort.

citations.quote: forage never take or store members cryptocurrency in any centralized location.
One hundred percent of all Beusd payments are sent instantly and directly to the members of Forçage
Income is not guaranteed

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing-credential point is beside the issue. The evidence expressly shows a deposit, progressively priced slots, and income tied to three partners activating slots and continuing through the matrix. A scam classification does not require the presenter to request private keys or personally hold funds. Calling the arrangement a promotion cannot erase the central recruitment-dependent return being advertised.
